authorization: User explicitly reopened r11 to obtain a verified kappa improvement through L-system patterns or sandpile analysis. Original round stays frozen.

controls: Unchanged literal baseline must pass all fill checks.
A no-op/self exchange must not be labelled improving.
An over-capacity mutation must be rejected.
A duplicated physical-family mutation in one call must be rejected.
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.exact_improvement_predicate: For original residuals rA,rB and d = widthA-widthB, residuals become rA+d,rB-d. Require 0<=rA+d<=capA, 0<=rB-d<=capB and d*(rA-rB+d)>0. Equal sum plus strict spread gives a strictly lower sum of residual p-powers for every 0<p<1.
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.incomplete: Any timeout, coverage gap, admission error or failed control prevents a scientific NULL/PASS decision.
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.move: Exchange the physical (owner, child) bins of two roles in the same call, retaining their helper IDs and widths. Both bins must remain within capacity, eligibility, coverage and physical-family constraints.
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.null_bar: Complete exhaustive pair census, no feasible improving pair, all controls pass. NULL is restricted to same-call pair exchanges on this pinned fill.
outputs: candidate FILL.json.gz and PROFILE.json for any selected witness
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.pass_bar: At least one concrete improving pair, with complete literal-fill and full-profile reconstruction passing, exact conserved rank mass and strict moment decrease. PASS is a constructive fill gain only; separate complete native/supplier/outer admission is mandatory for the user goal.
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.question: Does an exact simultaneous unequal-width pair exchange within one call improve the complete #2853 profile?
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.scope: All unordered pairs of the 408 literal role rows in each of 666 calls, at most 55296648 pairs per seed; enumeration order may vary by seed, candidate tie break is canonical. No changed words, dispatch, geometry, windows, or role inventory.
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.second_seed: Repeat complete census and checks with a different randomized traversal order; identical canonical selected witness and decision required.
C1-SAME-CALL-EXCHANGE.selection: Choose the feasible improving pair with largest integer increase in sum of squared residuals; canonical lexical pair breaks ties. Record aggregate candidate counts and selected witness, not raw enumeration.

resources.large_objects: load once in parent; workers receive indices
